cases.name: batch baseline restore, on a throwaway repo: patch saved, files back to batch start (snapshot copy or HEAD), created files deleted, snapshot consumed
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/restore-{{SID}}; B=$R.bl; rm -rf $R $B; mkdir -p $R/src/A $R/tests/T && cd $R && git init -q && printf 'v0
' > src/A/clean.cs && printf 'v0
' > src/A/dirty.cs && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/gone.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'start
' > src/A/dirty.cs && printf 'early
' > src/A/early.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $B --root $R >/dev/null && printf 'batch
' >> $R/src/A/clean.cs && printf 'batch
' >> $R/src/A/dirty.cs && printf 'batch
' > $R/src/A/early.cs && mkdir -p $R/src/New && printf 'new
' > $R/src/New/made.cs && rm $R/tests/T/gone.cs && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py restore $B --root $R --save $R.patch >/dev/null && echo "$(cat $R/src/A/clean.cs)|$(cat $R/src/A/dirty.cs)|$(cat $R/src/A/early.cs)|$(cat $R/tests/T/gone.cs)|$(test -e $R/src/New && echo kept || echo pruned)|$(test -e $B && echo snapshot || echo consumed)|$(grep -c '^+batch' $R.patch)|$(grep -c '^+++ b/src/New/made.cs' $R.patch)"

cases.name: batch baseline restore without a snapshot exits 2 and touches nothing
batch baseline diff names every changed path, --code leaves .md and .verified out, base prints the batch-start content (empty for a file created since)
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/diff-{{SID}}; B=$R.bl; rm -rf $R $B; mkdir -p $R/src/A $R/tests/T && cd $R && git init -q && printf 'v0
' > src/A/a.cs && printf 'v0
' > src/A/notes.md && printf 'v0
' > src/A/Snap.verified.txt && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'start
' > src/A/a.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $B --root $R >/dev/null && printf 'batch
' >> $R/src/A/a.cs && printf 'x
' >> $R/src/A/notes.md && printf 'x
' >> $R/src/A/Snap.verified.txt && printf 'new
' > $R/tests/T/n.cs && echo "$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py diff $B --root $R --name-only | tr '
' ',')|$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py diff $B --root $R --name-only --code | tr '
' ',')|$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py base $B src/A/a.cs --root $R)|$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py base $B tests/T/n.cs --root $R | wc -c | tr -d ' ')|$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py diff $B --root $R --code | grep -c '^+++ b/')"

cases.name: batch baseline scope comes from the kit.config.json roots, not from a fixed pair of folders
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/scope-{{SID}}; B=$R.bl; rm -rf $R $B; mkdir -p $R/app $R/spec $R/src $R/.claude && cd $R && git init -q && printf '{"layout": {"sources": {"roots": ["app"]}, "tests": {"roots": ["spec"]}}}
' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf 'v0
' > app/seed.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'x
' > app/x.cs && printf 'y
' > spec/y.cs && printf 'z
' > src/z.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $B --root $R >/dev/null && tr '
' ',' < $B/manifest.txt

cases.name: batch baseline with an unreadable kit.config.json exits 2
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/badconf-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude && printf '{ not json' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $R.bl --root $R
